title: asset-gen staged, grouped ComfyUI workflow templates per purpose, with a graph style guide and MCP authoring rule
goal: Make every workflow Claude builds or runs through comfy-mcp a dense, organised ComfyUI graph (framed groups, titled nodes, notes, left to right) derived from a per-purpose template, enforced by a lint, using API nodes and core image nodes only.

tasks.objective: Refactor tests/assetgen.test.sh so adding a core purpose or template touches only new files: compute the core entry count instead of the hard-coded 15 (line ~67), glob templates/assetgen/purposes/*.json instead of the hard-coded purpose loops (~161, ~301) and workflows/*.json instead of the template list (~205), replace the sorted id string (~69) by a check that every file basename is listed, make style_selftest core purposes data-driven, golden path golden/<purpose>.json for the default template and golden/<purpose>--<template>.json for variants, and an optional per-purpose cases file tests/fixtures/assetgen/cases/<purpose>.json holding extra render params (image-edit reference_image). No behaviour change: same assertions, same pass count.
acceptance: the suite passes with the same number of assertions as before
a new templates/assetgen/workflows/<id>.json or purposes/<id>.json no longer needs an edit of tests/assetgen.test.sh
image-edit still renders through a cases file, not a special case in the loop
no change under scripts/ or templates/

tasks.objective: Register the nodes the staged templates need. Add scripts/assetgen/nodesync.py (offline, reads a saved ComfyUI object_info JSON file, no network) that writes ordered known-nodes.json entries (required then optional inputs, exact combo options, outputs, ui.size, output_node flag); add entries for core image nodes ImageScale, ImageSharpen, ImageBlur, ImageInvert, ImageCrop, PreviewImage, SplitImageWithAlpha, JoinImageWithAlpha, ImageQuantize and PrimitiveString, and Note and MarkdownNote as ui_only nodes. lint.py keeps ui_only nodes out of the API graph and rejects them in a workflow. Use a saved object_info if one exists (comfy-mcp or a running ComfyUI), otherwise the documented core node signatures, and say which in the changelog. Fixture object_info for the offline test.
acceptance: nodesync output for the fixture object_info equals the committed entries
lint accepts the new core nodes in a template and rejects Note or MarkdownNote inside workflow
an unknown node or input is still a lint error
no network access in the engine or its test

tasks.objective: Make the ComfyUI-frontend graph organised like the reference image. Template gets an optional ui block, separate from workflow and never part of the API graph: groups (title, color, member node ids), notes (text, group), node colors, optional row hints. uiworkflow.to_ui computes each group's bounding from its member nodes' positions and sizes plus padding, orders columns by stage, emits groups, notes as ui_only Note nodes (ids above the API ids, last_node_id updated) and node color and bgcolor. The API graph and workflow.json do not change. Extend the inline UI-to-API converter in the test to skip ui_only nodes.
acceptance: a fixture template with a ui block renders groups whose bounding contains all member nodes and notes inside their group
the UI graph converts back to exactly the API graph (notes skipped)
templates without a ui block render as before (existing goldens unchanged)
workflow.json is identical with and without the ui block

tasks.objective: Enforce the workflow style guide. Add graph-lint (assetgen.py verb, plus rows in lint for templates and an optional check on a run's workflow.ui.json): every node has a title; every node belongs to exactly one group; group titles come from the vocabulary Prompt, References, Generate, Post-process, Preview, Output and appear left to right in that order; the reviewed prompt is linked directly from PrimitiveStringMultiline to NineRouterImage.user_prompt; exactly one NineRouterImage; every SaveImage has an inline filename suffix and PreviewImage is used for intermediates; no static LoadImage file name; each group has a Note. The quality plugin check workflow-style is a WARN first. Logic in a new scripts/assetgen/graphstyle.py with thin hookups.
acceptance: each rule has a passing and a failing fixture and the message names the node
the legacy image-generate and image-edit templates are reported WARN, never FAIL
graph-lint exits 0 for a clean template, 1 for a violation, 2 for usage
the quality plugin check is WARN and unchanged for runs without workflow.ui.json

tasks.objective: Write the rule for an agent that creates or changes a ComfyUI workflow through comfy-mcp. New skills/comfyui/references/workflow-style.md: the stage blueprint with groups, titles, notes and colors, the allowed node set, the limits (reviewed prompt wired directly, one NineRouterImage, SaveImage only for deliverables, no static LoadImage, no URLs). Rule in skills/comfyui/SKILL.md: start from the purpose's template (core or a game-layer extends), then lint, graph-lint and a live validate_workflow before any run_workflow; never run a graph edited through set_workflow_slot without rendering it again; no free-form graph. skills/asset-gen/SKILL.md names the rule within its 160-line cap. Cite code by anchor symbol and docs by section.
acceptance: comfyui SKILL.md and asset-gen SKILL.md stay at most 160 lines and comfyui has at most 3 references
skills-lint and skill-citations pass
no instruction allows running a graph that did not come from render, or approving a run

tasks.objective: Moved from plan assetgen-hybrid because this plan's staged-icon causes the bug and its integration QA failed on it. Start from the earlier attempt on branch feat/assetgen/hybrid-output-filter: cherry-pick its commits 6100774 (classify run outputs as SaveImage, preview or unknown; budget counts deliverables only) and d122721 (finalize moves PreviewImage files out of outputs/ first; gen-run-outputs requires outputs/ paths) onto this task branch; they touch only engine, check and test files of this plan. Its uncommitted tests/assetgen.test.sh change and tests/fixtures/assetgen/comfy-job-state.json in that worktree may be read and reused. Real bug from the plan D live e2e (one generation on staged-icon): comfy-mcp fetch_outputs also downloads the PreviewImage temp file into <run>/outputs/, so finalize and qa grade the 64 px preview as a second deliverable (png-size FAIL) and manifest would record it. Keep only the deliverables: after fetch, the engine moves every file in outputs/ that was not written by a SaveImage output node of the rendered workflow (match the run's filename_prefix and the SaveImage suffixes; PreviewImage files carry ComfyUI temp names) to <run>/previews/, before defringe, embed and qa; finalize does it as its first step and reports what it moved; nothing is deleted; the gen-run-outputs check ignores previews/. Runs whose outputs are all SaveImage files behave exactly as today. Facts from the live e2e: only staged-icon adds a 64 px PreviewImage today (staged-turnaround previews at full size, staged-sprite and staged-edit have none); fetched files are named <promptid8>_000.png and _001.png, so tell them apart by the SaveImage records of the rendered workflow, not by name alone. The budget counted the preview and an earlier failed attempt (3 of 4 used after one generation): previews/ files never count as outputs in budget. Also correct the domain doc: docs/architecture/domains/assetgen.md (around line 113) says PreviewImage fetching is unverified; the live e2e (docs/plans/assetgen-workflows/e2e.md) proved fetch_outputs brings PreviewImage files, and after this fix finalize moves them to previews/. The fetched files carry no type and the comfy-cli job state can stay 'queued' with no outputs, so the agent saves the free read-only fetch_outputs url_only result as <run>/fetch.json (type output or temp per file, in fetch order); finalize and budget read it first and the job state only as a fallback. Update the run sequence in skills/asset-gen/SKILL.md step 6 and skills/comfyui/SKILL.md to save fetch.json after fetch_outputs; both files are at their 160-line cap, so replace text, never add a line.

no file is deleted
